breadcrumb: Std 6 Science (English) — Unit 5: The World of Animals — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: In Jurong Birds Park, Singapore, Penguins are kept in a big glass case with ice bergs and the temperature is maintained at 0 degree C and below.

en.q: In which park are penguins kept in a glass case with icebergs at 0 degree C and below?
en.explanation: Penguins are kept at 0 degree C and below in Jurong Birds Park.

ta.q: பனிப்பாறைகளுடன் 0°C-க்குக் கீழ் வெப்பநிலையில் பென்குயின்கள் வைக்கப்பட்டுள்ள பூங்கா எது?
ta.explanation: ஜுராங் பூங்காவில் பென்குயின்கள் 0°C-க்கும் குறைவான வெப்பநிலையில் வைக்கப்படுகின்றன.

questions.quote: Animals change their location as the season changes. It is called migration.

en.q: The movement of animals from one place to another as the season changes is called ______.
en.explanation: Birds that migrate are called migratory birds.

ta.q: பருவம் மாறும்போது விலங்குகள் இடம் மாறுவது ______ எனப்படும்.

questions.quote: In Tamil Nadu bird sanctuaries are located at Vedanthangal, Kodiyakkarai and Koondhankulam. Many birds from foreign countries like Siberia and Russia migrate to Vedanthangal.

en.q: Which of these is a bird sanctuary in Tamil Nadu mentioned in the book?
en.explanation: Birds from Siberia and Russia migrate to Vedanthangal.

ta.q: நூலில் கூறப்பட்ட தமிழ்நாட்டின் பறவைகள் சரணாலயம் எது?
ta.explanation: சைபீரியா, ரஷ்யா பறவைகள் வேடந்தாங்கலுக்கு வலசை வருகின்றன.

questions.quote: Spending winters in a dormant condition is called hibernation (Winter sleep). Eg. Turtle

en.q: Spending the winter in a dormant condition is called ______.

questions.quote: Spending the hot and dry period in an inactive state is known as aestivation (Summer sleep). Eg. Snail

en.explanation: Aestivation is spending the hot and dry period in an inactive state.

ta.explanation: வெப்பமும் வறட்சியும் உள்ள காலத்தை செயலற்ற நிலையில் கழிப்பது கோடைகால உறக்கம்.

questions.quote: Kangaroo rat does not drink water at all. It obtains the required water from the seed it eats.

en.q: The kangaroo rat gets the water it needs from ______.

ta.q: கங்காரு எலி தனக்குத் தேவையான நீரை ______ இலிருந்து பெறுகிறது.

questions.quote: The mountain goat namely Nilgiri Tahr can find small spaces on rock to climb with ease and keep its balance as it feeds.

en.q: The mountain goat of the Nilgiris is the ______.
en.explanation: It finds small spaces on rock to climb with ease.

ta.explanation: பாறைகளில் சிறு இடங்களைக் கண்டு எளிதாக ஏறும்.

questions.quote: The living things form biotic community and non-living things form abiotic community.

en.q: Which of the following is an abiotic component?
en.explanation: Living things are biotic; non-living things are abiotic.

questions.quote: Amoeba swallows food from the water and the food is digested in the food vacuole. Contractile vacuoles help in excretion.

en.q: In amoeba, excretion is helped by the ______.
en.explanation: The contractile vacuole collects excess water and wastes and pushes them out of the amoeba.

ta.explanation: சுருங்கு நுண்குமிழ் மிகையான நீரையும் கழிவையும் சேகரித்து அமீபாவிலிருந்து வெளியேற்றுகிறது.

questions.quote: Euglena is an unicellular animal which moves with a flagellum.

en.q: Euglena moves with the help of a ______.
en.explanation: Euglena moves by lashing its whip-like flagellum.

ta.explanation: யூக்ளினா சாட்டை போன்ற கசையிழையை அசைத்து நகர்கிறது.

questions.quote: Growth occurs by an increase in the number of cells by cell division in multicellular organisms.

en.q: In multicellular organisms, growth occurs by ______.
options: an increase in the size of the single cell
an increase in the number of cells by cell division
en.explanation: In unicellular organisms, growth occurs by an increase in cell size.

questions.quote: Amphibians lead a dual mode of life, living both in water and land. They are poikilothermic animals. During the larval stage, frog respire with the help of gills.

en.q: The larval stage of a frog respires with the help of ______.
en.explanation: The tadpole (larva) lives in water and breathes with gills; the adult frog uses lungs and skin.

ta.explanation: தலைப்பிரட்டை (லார்வா) நீரில் வாழ்ந்து செவுள்களால் சுவாசிக்கிறது; வளர்ந்த தவளை நுரையீரலையும் தோலையும் பயன்படுத்துகிறது.

questions.quote: The fish has strong tail fin which acts as rudder to change direction and keep its body balance in water.

en.q: In a fish, the strong tail fin acts as a ______.
en.explanation: The tail fin changes direction and keeps the body balance in water.

ta.q: மீனின் வலிமையான வால் துடுப்பு ______ ஆகச் செயல்படுகிறது.
ta.explanation: வால் துடுப்பு திசையை மாற்றி உடல் சமநிலையைப் பேணும்.

questions.quote: Camel: A camel's hump has fat stored in it. Large and flat padded feet. Thus it is called 'Ship of the desert'.

en.q: The animal called the 'Ship of the desert' is the ______.
en.explanation: Its large flat padded feet help it walk on soft sand.

ta.explanation: அதன் அகன்ற பாதங்கள் மணலில் நடக்க உதவுகின்றன.

questions.quote: Some lizards ... In these lizards, the tail is held out backward and upward and acts as a counterweight.

en.q: In lizards that run on two legs, the tail acts as a ______.
en.explanation: The tail is held out backward and upward.

ta.q: இரு கால்களில் ஓடும் பல்லிகளில் வால் ______ ஆகச் செயல்படுகிறது.
